acts.words: Don't look at us like that, Leo, you're the one who keeps plotting behind our backs.
One of these is missing. Did one of you take it?
Who took it? One of us must have taken it.
I didn't take it, and none of us would do that to each other.
I didn't take it, and neither did anyone who actually thinks before they act.
I didn't take it, I swear I didn't!
I'm telling you it was Leo, he's the one who's always questioning everything we do.
I'm going to look around, I want to prove it wasn't me.
Check his pockets, he's the one who's been acting shady this whole time.
If it didn't walk off the shelf by itself, it's somewhere in this room.
acts.came_of_it: went through the room and found nothing.

acts.words: I'm not stopping until I find where that can went.
acts.came_of_it: went through the room and found nothing.

acts.words: Open your jacket again Leo, you're hiding something and I know it.
If none of us took it and it didn't walk off by itself, someone in this room needs to explain where it went.
If none of us took it, then where did it go? Who actually moved it?
I didn't take anything, and I'm tired of everyone looking at me like I'm the problem.
You're the one so obsessed with being in charge, Daniel, maybe you're the one who hid it.
I didn't take anything, why are you all looking at me like that?
I already told you it wasn't me, stop staring at me like I'm a thief.
Let's not fight, we will divide what is here right now so everyone has their share.
acts.came_of_it: shared out the last 2 portions between Elena, Daniel, Leo, Mara.

acts.words: Leo kept telling everyone to let someone else handle it, maybe he's the one who took it to save for himself.
I didn't touch it, I swear to you, and I won't have you all looking at me like this.
Please, stop arguing, we are all we have left. No one is to blame.
I didn't take it, and accusing each other isn't going to make the food come back.
I didn't take the food, and I won't have you all sitting here glaring at me like I'm some kind of criminal.
